title: Finding any document later
description: Find a document by a word printed on it, open the scanned page, zoom, and jump to a word in the page with in-document find (works on scans). Search covers everything brought in — filed or still in Review (the 'include unconfirmed' box is on by default).

steps.narration: Once your documents are in, you rarely need the folders again. Search finds any of them in seconds — by who sent it, a date, an amount, or any word printed inside.
steps.caption: Find any document in seconds

steps.narration: Open Search from the side bar.
steps.caption: 1. Click Search

steps.narration: Type anything that appears on the document — here, a supplier's name. Every word on every page is read as it comes in, so all of it is searchable, not just the file name.
steps.caption: 2. Type a word from the document

steps.narration: Every match is listed on the left, with its sender, type and date. Search covers everything you've brought in — filed documents and any still waiting in Review.
steps.caption: Matches on the left

steps.narration: Click one, and its page opens on the right.
steps.caption: 4. Click a result

steps.narration: That's the actual scanned page, exactly as it was brought in — no hunting through folders.
steps.caption: The scanned page, as filed

steps.narration: Zoom in to read the small print.
steps.caption: 5. Zoom in

steps.narration: To jump straight to a word on the page — an amount, a part number — type it into the find box. This works even on scans, because the text was actually read, not just pictured.
steps.caption: 6. Find a word on the page

steps.narration: Each match is highlighted on the page, and Next steps through them.
steps.caption: 7. Next match

steps.narration: When a word alone isn't enough, narrow it down with the filters along the top — a date range, an amount, or the document type.
steps.caption: Filters: date · amount · type

steps.narration: That's Search — every word on every page, the moment a document is brought in.
steps.caption: Every word, every page, searchable
